  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Take a new sauce pan, place therein the {{ing_01|chestnuts carefully cleaned}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Add {{ing_02|water}} and {{ing_03|a little soda}} and place on the fire to be cooked."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "This done, crush in the mortar {{ing_04|pepper}}, {{ing_05|cumin}}, {{ing_06|coriander seed}}, {{ing_07|mint}}, {{ing_08|rue}}, {{ing_09|laser root}} and {{ing_10|flea-bane}} moistened with {{ing_11|vinegar}}, {{ing_12|honey}} and {{ing_13|broth}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Add {{ing_11|vinegar}} to taste and pour this over the cooked {{ing_01|chestnuts}}, add {{ing_14|oil}} and allow to boil."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "When done crush it in the mortar."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "Taste to see if something is missing and if so, put it in, and at last add {{ing_15|green [fresh virgin] oil}}."
    }
